notes.title: Get ready to meet your next favorite videogame crab in The Dungeon Experience
notes.notes: The Dungeon Experience is a videogame about a theme park dungeon held together by strings. The theme park, I mean, not the videogame. It's got an uncanny animatronic barbarian and cardboard cutout monsters, the Lake of Pain is an inflatable kiddie pool, and the host is a mudcrab. Co-creator Jacob Janerka tells me he's workshopping a pitch to sum up this unusual concept. "The Dungeon Experience is like The Stanley Parable," he says, "but the narrator is a talking crab who reads self-help books and has a hundred-dollar budget.".. Read more.

notes.title: Dungeon Experience Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you all for being so patient waiting for the Dungeon Experience! I wanted to let you all know I'm not dead and still working super hard on the game. On Steam I may seem non-existent, but most of my goblin like qualities can be found on [url=https://twitter.com/JacobJanerka]Twitter.[/url] I also wanted to say to people still waiting for release since the very beginning, I really appreciate it so much, truly. 

This week we just hit a HUGE milestone and have the games grey box done (basically a solid draft) of the whole game playable from start to finish. Me and the team have been going goblin mode chasing this milestone for awhile so its pretty exciting to see the game in all its glory and can really see how awesome it is shaping up. We're getting a small group of testers starting soon to look me dead in the eyes and tell me my poop jokes could be better.

Some of you may be like "hey Jacob, I've had like 10 children since you first announced this, why isn't it done" That is true the game went through a lot of iterations and reworks before we landed on something good. 3D was also a bigger hurdle than I expected vs my original 2D point and click adventure (Paradigm). However the momentum we have now though has been amazing, especially since our new programmer came on board a little while back so I can focus much more on the said poop jokes and not coding. Soon we're bringing some more contractors on board, so it's really exciting to see how it's shaping up. I also hope you named your 10 children all Jacob.

Anyway much love to you all. I hope to be updating everyone more often
Jacob 

Follow me on Twitter for more frequent updates
[url=https://twitter.com/JacobJanerka]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: There's nary a nip to be seen in The Dungeon Experience's full reveal
notes.notes:
Okay, so there may be one or two. But they’re not the focal point of the piece, which is more than could be said for Jacob Janerka’s previous attempt to snag wishlists for The Dungeon Experience. After failing to draw eyes on the game by way of viral embarrassment, the Aussie dev is trying a more traditional approach with a proper reveal trailer. Sometimes you’ve just gotta stick with what works, y’know?

notes.title: Viral nipples don't sell games, one developer sadly discovers
notes.notes:
Have you ever wondered what the engagement value is on posting a banger? Have you ever read the exact words: “damn, this went viral, check out my Soundcloud,” and wondered how many people actually checked out that Soundcloud? Paradigm and The Dungeon Experience developer Jacob Janerka wondered too. Following the surprise success of a topless tweet, Janerka decisively proved one of two things – either Twitter isn’t driving wishlist engagement, or bare nipples just ain’t the marketing gold they used to be.
